Review complete. Verdict: **approve** (tier2 — held for human sign-off, not auto-merge).

Summary: this diff closes three real ERP PM gaps — PMS timesheet-to-invoice generation (transaction-atomic, sound anti-double-billing via `withTenantContext`), cross-project resource-conflict detection (correctly distinct from the existing per-project `getWorkload()`), and a verified no-op on the Gantt UI gap (confirmed by direct code inspection that PROJEXA already shipped it, not trusted from the self-report). All new routes are properly org-scoped/auth-gated, the migration and invoice-numbering pattern match established repo conventions rather than introducing new bugs, and tests cover the meaningful edge cases. No `.github/workflows/**` changes. Two minor, non-blocking issues noted (a missing `requirePmsEnabled` gate on the invoice route, and silent NaN-swallowing on a malformed query param — both flagged in `review-verdict.json`, written to the repo root as requested.
